businessName: Dental Delight (An initiative by AIIMS Delhi Alumni)
whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Dental Delight,

I noticed your dental clinic has outstanding 4.9★ reviews from 300+ patients in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new patient appointments.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, AIIMS Delhi alumni trust highlights, aur treatment categories integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dentaldelight

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Dental Delight team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with AIIMS Delhi alumni trust credentials, mobile-first speed, and direct WhatsApp appointment booking for patients in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
